items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production image-led reel cabinet for a premium 5x3 Hold & Win mobile slot. Primary request: one wide horizontal celestial vault machine panel, symmetrical, ornate but clean, deep navy metal, royal violet enamel, luminous cyan crystal corners, restrained molten-gold beveled trim, large completely empty near-black navy rectangular inset center sized for five columns and three rows. Style: premium polished stylized 3D commercial mobile game UI, crisp edges, controlled bloom. Composition: centered 3:2 landscape object, front view, fills canvas, dark navy background seamlessly merging with panel. Constraints: no symbols, no reels, no character, no buttons, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark; center opening must be quiet, flat and low-contrast for composited reel symbols.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium jackpot header panel for a 5x3 Hold & Win mobile slot. Primary request: one wide celestial treasury header with four evenly spaced jewel chambers, each chamber framed in deep navy metal, violet enamel and restrained molten gold, cyan starcore energy flowing behind them, four clean dark inset cartouches reserved for runtime jackpot labels and values. Style: polished stylized 3D commercial mobile game UI, coherent with an astral observatory vault, crisp bevels, controlled glow. Composition: centered horizontal 3:2 asset, front view, dominant long header in middle with dark navy background. Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no currency symbols, no characters, no slot symbols, no logo, no watermark; keep all four cartouches clean and high contrast for Cocos labels.
